red_tests.failure_fingerprint: 11 failed, 4 passed; KAN269_ENTRYPOINT_DRIFT: both wrangler configs still set main = api/index.js while the live Worker runs project/static/_worker.js, and [env.production] omits the non-inheritable vars/kv_namespaces

rationale: Freeze the KAN-269 deploy-topology contract before source work. The live Worker horoconsultant-production runs project/static/_worker.js (proven by its unique X-Cost-Guardrail / X-R2-Policy headers, plus /manifest.json -> 404 and /api/index -> 404, while the separate Pages artifact horoconsultant-pages.pages.dev serves those assets). No tracked pipeline reproduces that artifact: both wrangler configs on main set main = api/index.js, and the dashboard shows every version as 'Manually deployed Wrangler by pansakorn' with 'No builds exist yet'. Per the Cloudflare environments reference an environment deploys as <top-level-name>-<environment-name>, so name = horoconsultant with -e production already yields horoconsultant-production; only the entry point is wrong. The same reference states vars and kv_namespaces are non-inheritable, so [env.production] must declare them itself — it currently does not, leaving the production Worker without BACKEND_BASE_URL and without the CACHE binding. The contract tests that pinned main = api/index.js are updated in this same commit rather than deleted.
